content.intro: M5: Energy Governance for a Just Energy Transition | Chapter 2

content.text: A robust policy and regulatory framework is essential for effective energy governance. This section examines the development of policies and regulations that support a just energy transition, emphasizing the importance of political economy analysis, stakeholder engagement, policy coherence, foresight, adaptive policies and regulations, and de-risking investments.
